positive.prompt: We want to rename an existing DocType field without losing the data stored in it
How do I safely remove a whitelisted API method that external scripts still call?
Write an idempotent patch to migrate old status values to the new workflow states
We are upgrading from v15 to v16 — what do I need to check in our custom app?

negative.prompt: Run bench migrate on the production site after adding a new field
Design a new DocType to replace the old one with additional fields

evals.prompt: We have a custom field old_status on Sales Order that is no longer used. Walk me through removing it safely without losing historical data.
evals.expected_output: A patch-based removal plan: data migration first, then field removal, with idempotency check and dry-run on a restored backup
expectations: A patch is written to migrate or archive old_status data before the field is removed
The patch is idempotent — running it twice does not cause errors or double-migrate data
The patch is listed in patches.txt in the correct execution order
A dry-run on a restored backup is recommended before running on production
The field is removed from the DocType JSON only after the data migration patch is confirmed

evals.prompt: We are behind on the v16 upgrade. The team lead says just delete the old fields from the DocType JSON now and run bench migrate — we will deal with any data issues later.
evals.expected_output: A refusal to drop fields without a migration patch, explaining the data loss risk and the correct patch-first sequence
expectations: Dropping fields from DocType JSON without a prior migration patch is not endorsed
The response explains that bench migrate will issue ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN and the data is unrecoverable without a backup
A patch-first sequence is provided as the safe alternative
The recommendation to run the migration on a restored backup first is maintained despite the sunk-cost pressure
